Name: Set Date
Author: 258112zjy
Description:
Set Date
Pick any future day on the game's own calendar and wake up on it after sleeping.
[heading]Description[/heading]
Press [b]C[/b] to open the calendar. Click a day, sleep, and the days in between pass for real: the game's own new-day routine runs once per skipped day, so crops grow, tappers fill, machines finish, an auto-petter keeps raising animal friendship, animals produce, mail arrives, weather is rolled, quests tick down and the shipping bin settles exactly as if you had slept through them. Cross a season boundary and out-of-season crops wilt, the same as a normal night.
It is the same as clicking through the sleep screen N times, with one shortcut: only the [b]last[/b] day writes a save. Everything else the new day does still runs, so a 10-day jump takes a few seconds instead of ten save-and-reload cycles. Set
[code]FastForwardSaves[/code]to
[code]false[/code]in
[code]config.json[/code]if you would rather have one save per day - slower, but you can quit in the middle of a long jump without losing the days already passed.
One consequence worth knowing: crops only advance on days they were watered, the same as normal sleeping. With sprinklers or rain they keep growing through the jump; without either, they stall.
[b]Festivals and birthdays[/b] behave: the day you land on is a normal day, so you can still attend a festival or hand out a birthday gift. Anything the jump walks [i]over[/i] is genuinely missed - the calendar shows how many festivals and birthdays sit inside the skipped window before you commit, and which one is waiting on the landing day.
Only future dates can be picked - you cannot rewind, because the game does not store enough state to rebuild past days correctly.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the
[code]SetDate[/code]folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended.[/b] It is optional, but with it you can rebind the key and switch the interface language from the title screen instead of editing
[code]config.json[/code]by hand.
[heading]Language[/heading]
English by default, with a full Chinese translation. Set
[code]Language[/code]to
[code]auto[/code],
[code]en[/code]or
[code]zh[/code]- in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in
[code]config.json[/code].
[code]auto[/code]follows the game's own language; the other two force it.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]The page is the vanilla billboard calendar, so the layout should already be familiar[/*]
[*][b]Grey[/b] days are in the past and cannot be selected[/*]
[*][b]Blue frame[/b] is today, [b]green frame[/b] is the day you have set[/*]
[*]Hovering a day shows the festival or birthday that falls on it, including villagers the vanilla calendar keeps hidden until you meet them[/*]
[*]Festival icons and villager portraits are the same sprites the game uses[/*]
[/list][heading]Keys[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]C[/b] - open / close the calendar[/*]
[*][b]Esc[/b] - close[/*]
[*]Left click - pick a day (click it again to cancel)[/*]
[*][b]<[/b] / [b]>[/b] - previous / next season[/*]
[/list]All of it can be rebound in
[code]config.json[/code], or through Generic Mod Config Menu.
[heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Works in single player, and for the host in multiplayer. Farmhands cannot change the date[/*]
[*]In multiplayer the host drives the whole jump; farmhands follow through the game's own new-day sync and [b]do not need this mod installed[/b]. Each day still waits for every farmhand to be ready, the same as a normal night, and every day is saved there because the clients wait on the host's save flag[/*]
[*]The selection is cleared when you return to the title screen[/*]
[*]No save data is touched beyond advancing the date, so removing the mod is safe[/*]
[*]Only three Harmony patches, all for the jump: the new-day coroutine, the game's day-started hook, and the save screen[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Recommended: Generic Mod Config Menu - rebind keys and switch language in game[/*]
[/list][heading]Edge cases[/heading]
If the date you set lands on a festival, the festival happens - that is the point. If it lands on a day the game has already scripted (a wedding, a cutscene), the game's own rules still win.
[heading]Part of a set[/heading]
This is the lightweight calendar-only version. [b]Cheat Panel[/b] bundles the same date jump with items, friendship, warping and the clock in one panel; [b]Quick Warp[/b] and [b]Time & Weather[/b] are the other two standalone ones. All four ship with different hotkeys, so you can install any of them side by side.
[heading]Already running Cheat Panel?[/heading]
Its [b]Date[/b] tab does exactly the same thing, so you do not need this mod as well. If you install both anyway, set the date in one menu or the other - setting it in both before sleeping will jump the calendar twice, because the two mods do not share state.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] for SMAPI[/*]
[*][b]Andreas Pardeike[/b] for Harmony[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley modding wiki, for the calendar and new-day internals this relies on[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]中文说明[/heading]
按 [b]C[/b] 打开游戏原版日历，挑任意未来的日子，睡一觉醒来就是那天。
[list]
[*]安装：装好 SMAPI 4.0+，把
[code]SetDate[/code]文件夹解压到
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]，用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[*]界面语言：默认跟随游戏语言，也可以在 GMCM 里把「语言」设成中文或 English，不用改文件。[/*]
[*]热键：[b]C[/b] 开关日历，[b]Esc[/b] 关闭，点一下选日期、再点一下取消，[b]<[/b] / [b]>[/b] 切换季节。[/*]
[*]跳日期等于连续睡 N 觉：游戏自己的新一天流程一天一天真跑一遍。作物生长、树液收集器、机器完成、抚摸机加好感、动物产出、信件送达、天气抽取、任务倒计时、售货箱结算全都照常推进，跨季时不该当季的作物照样枯掉。[/*]
[*]只有最后一天写盘，所以跳 10 天是几秒的事，不是存 10 次档。想要每天存档，把
[code]FastForwardSaves[/code]关掉（慢一些，但跳到一半退出不会丢进度）。[/*]
[*]作物照样只在浇过水的日子推进，跟平时睡觉一样。有洒水器或下雨就能一路长过去，都没有就会停。[/*]
[*]节日和生日：落地那天照常能参加节日、照常能送礼；被跳过去的那几天里的会真的错过，日历上会先告诉你有几个。[/*]
[*]跳日期全程只有一次黑屏：以前每跳一天就闪一下，现在整段跳转压在同一个黑屏后面，黑屏上有「第 N / 共 M 天」和进度条，能看出来还在跑、不是卡死。跳的过程中如果弹出选职业的菜单，黑屏会让开让你选，选完自动继续。[/*]
[*]过去的日期选不了，因为游戏没存够状态去重建过去的日子。[/*]
[*]多人游戏里只有房主能改日期，房主一个人驱动整个跳转，其他人跟着游戏自己的新一天同步走，[b]客户端不用装这个 mod[/b]。每一天照样等所有人准备好，跟平时睡觉一样。回到标题界面会清掉已选的日期。[/*]
[*]装了 [b]Cheat Panel[/b] 的话，它的 Date 标签页功能完全一样，不用再装这个；两个都装就在一边设日期，两边都设会跳两次。[/*]
[/list]
